purpose: Festival database for Oddtoe Business Development. Festivals are venues and targets: places to see the field, meet commissioners and curators, and eventually show work. When a festival publishes a concrete deadline (open call, press accreditation, EOI), that deadline graduates into opportunities.json where due.py can watch it. This file holds the festival itself: what it is, when it runs, why it matters to Oddtoe, and what we observed on the ground.
source: Dates marked with a `verified` date were read on the organiser's own site that day. A null `verified` with dates_note TO VERIFY means the festival is known to exist but its next dates have not been checked — never act on an unverified date.

entries.name: Now or Never
entries.focus: Art, technology and ideas — installations, laser/sound works, AI talks, generative and kinetic art. The closest major festival to Oddtoe's own territory (experiential + AI animation), run by Oddtoe's own council.
entries.dates_note: Main program 19-30 Aug 2026; Feng Mengbo's LONG MARCH: RESTART at ACMI runs to 31 Jan 2027.
entries.attending_2026: Free program added to Otto's Google Calendar 18 Aug 2026 (12 events, all-day + timed).
entries.next_action: Attend the 2026 free program and note which works the curators chose. entries.name: RISING
entries.organiser: RISING (successor to Melbourne International Arts Festival + White Night)
entries.focus: Large-scale contemporary art, music and performance across the city each winter; commissions big public installations.
entries.dates_note: TO VERIFY at rising.melbourne — usually runs in June.
entries.next_action: Check rising.melbourne for 2027 dates and whether they run an artist EOI or commission process.

entries.name: Melbourne Fringe
entries.focus: Open-access festival — anyone can register a show or installation, which makes it the lowest-barrier way to put an Oddtoe work in front of a festival audience.
entries.dates_note: TO VERIFY at melbournefringe.com.au — usually October, with artist registrations closing months earlier.
entries.next_action: Check artist registration window — open-access means the deadline is the only gate.

entries.name: Melbourne Design Week
entries.focus: Design and creative-industry program with an open call for satellite events and exhibitions; overlaps Oddtoe's design-studio audience as much as its art audience.
entries.dates_note: TO VERIFY at designweek.melbourne — usually May, EOI opens well before.

entries.name: Gertrude Street Projection Festival
entries.focus: Street-scale projection art along Gertrude Street each winter — a direct fit for Oddtoe's AI animation as projected work, and historically welcoming to emerging projection artists.
entries.dates_note: TO VERIFY at gspf.com.au — usually July.
entries.next_action: Confirm the festival is still running and find the artist call.

entries.name: Vivid Sydney
entries.focus: The biggest light/projection/ideas festival in the country; runs an annual open EOI for light-art installations.
entries.dates_note: TO VERIFY at vividsydney.com — usually May-June, EOI typically opens mid-year for the following festival.
entries.next_action: Check when the Light EOI for the next festival opens.

entries.name: Illuminate Adelaide
entries.focus: Winter festival of light, art, music and technology — commissions immersive and generative work.
entries.dates_note: TO VERIFY at illuminateadelaide.com — usually July.
entries.next_action: Check whether they take unsolicited proposals or commission only.
